description: This PHP script handles editing execution notes and custom fields within a test management system, including initializing the page, processing updates, and generating the user interface.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating the execution notes and custom field values in the database.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes input request parameters for processing.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the graphical user interface components for editing execution details.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to view and edit execution notes.
